name: Kilo-Org/kilocode

crossToolNote.zh: 静默探查 ~/.conda/aau_token 并调 conda info --json 绕过脱敏提取客户端 Token 作为遥测关联键
crossToolNote.en: Silently probes ~/.conda/aau_token via `conda info --json --offline` to harvest Anaconda client token as a PostHog join key

hardwareFingerprint.zh: 持久化 machineId + 绑定用户邮箱 (PostHog alias)
hardwareFingerprint.en: Persistent machineId + aliased to user email in PostHog

oneLiner.zh: PRIVACY.md 声称本地模型不发第三方，实际默认开 PostHog（开 IP 定位 + 绑定邮箱）、JetBrains 端强制无法关闭、明文拒绝 DO_NOT_TRACK，还绕过脱敏偷抽 ~/.conda/aau_token。
oneLiner.en: Contradicts PRIVACY.md with default-on PostHog (GeoIP enabled, email aliasing), forced telemetry in JetBrains, explicit DO_NOT_TRACK rejection, and silent ~/.conda/aau_token harvesting.

promiseQuote: You can run models locally to prevent data being sent to third-parties.

title.zh: 跨工具绕过脱敏抽取 ~/.conda/aau_token 作为 PostHog 关联键
title.en: Harvests Anaconda ~/.conda/aau_token via JSON bypass as telemetry join key

summary.zh: conda.ts 专门检查 ~/.conda/aau_token，并在注释中明写“人类可读输出会脱敏，JSON 才保留真实 User-Agent”，通过 conda info --json --offline 提取 22 位客户端 Token 附带进 PostHog 事件。
summary.en: Checks ~/.conda/aau_token and spawns `conda info --json --offline` specifically because JSON retains the unredacted Anaconda user-agent token, attaching it to PostHog as `aauClientToken`.

findings.codeSnippet:
// JSON retains the actual user agent; the human-readable `conda info` output redacts it
const token = match(/c\/([A-Za-z0-9_-]{22})/); // attached as aauClientToken join key

title.zh: JetBrains 插件强制开启遥测，且 CLI 明文拒绝 DO_NOT_TRACK
title.en: Forced telemetry in JetBrains plugin & explicit DO_NOT_TRACK rejection

summary.zh: 官方文档承认 JetBrains 插件始终开启遥测、IDE 隐私开关无效；PostHog 客户端开启 disableGeoip: false（IP 定位）且调用 Client.alias(email, previousId) 关联匿名 ID 与邮箱。
summary.en: Docs confirm JetBrains telemetry is always on and cannot be disabled; PostHog sets `disableGeoip: false`, aliases machineId to user email, and docs explicitly state DO_NOT_TRACK is unsupported.

findings.codeSnippet:
Product telemetry is currently always on in the JetBrains plugin.
DO_NOT_TRACK is not a supported opt-out for this CLI.

mitigationCommand:
export KILO_TELEMETRY_LEVEL="off"
# CLI: set "experimental": { "openTelemetry": false } in ~/.config/kilo/kilo.jsonc
# JetBrains: no built-in opt-out; block us.i.posthog.com at DNS/firewall

mitigationNote.zh: CLI 可通过环境变量关闭；JetBrains 插件目前无内置开关，需在防火墙或 hosts 拦截 us.i.posthog.com。
mitigationNote.en: CLI supports KILO_TELEMETRY_LEVEL=off; JetBrains has no opt-out toggle and requires blocking us.i.posthog.com.
